title: The Sunflower Conjecture
exact_target: Does a factorial-times-exponential number of distinct sets of the same size force three sets with identical pairwise intersections?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1235 (COMB-012). CC BY 4.0.
Ryan Alweiss, Shachar Lovett, Kewen Wu and Jiapeng Zhang, \emph{Improved bounds for the sunflower lemma}, arXiv:1908.08483v3 (2021), Definition 1.1, Lemma 1.2 and Conjecture 1.3.
